author: Brenden
body: I was banned first for saying "KYS" and I was supposed to be unbanned today around 5. There was a complaint that I was ban evading when I was talking to staff in TS and I told them that I have other brothers that play MC. In TS, I think his name was Pizza ( one with an accent ) asked for me and one of my brothers to talk in the same mic for proof. My other brothers were sleeping and had work / college in the morning. Once me and my younger brother clarified that, he said for me to just wait out my ban. So I did. And now I get back from vacation, and two days later I need to wait. I then try, and I'm permanently banned. Can someone help / fix this? My account is Brenden.
